snippetTypes.label: Script
snippetTypes.notes: Checked before SCRIPT_STEPS because whole scripts also contain <Step> elements.

snippetTypes.label: Tables
snippetTypes.notes: Checked before FIELD_DEFINITION because table snippets contain <Field> elements.

snippetTypes.label: Layout objects
snippetTypes.notes: Checked before FIELD_DEFINITION because layout objects can reference <Field> elements. The legacy Mac-XML alias is also written for compatibility.

detection.rule: Walk snippetTypes in array order; the first type whose detectIfContainsAny has a case-sensitive substring match wins. No match (or empty text) means UNKNOWN, and no FileMaker format is written.

customFormatPayload.lengthPrefix: uint32 little-endian byte length of the UTF-8 payload that follows
customFormatPayload.newlines: LF (CRLF and lone CR are converted to LF before encoding)

windows.write: In one clipboard session: CF_UNICODETEXT plus the type's format, then any aliases, all with the same customFormatPayload bytes.

macos.notes: FileMaker's pasteboard type names on macOS have not been captured yet (see docs/MacPasteboardResearch.md). Both plugins write plain text only on macOS.
